answer: Sybil resistance comes from decaying reputation and trust structure: each score loses half its weight after a fixed temporal half-life, so influence requires sustained honest service rather than a brief burst. In the EigenTrust matrix, a fresh identity has few reciprocal, trusted paths and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot bootstrap it. An opal, relic, or cedar-named account thus cannot pass consensus on creation alone.
